Title: 503203-2026: France – Architectural services – International architectural competition for the creation of new access points and spaces within the Louvre Museum and the development of its surroundings as part of the Louvre - Grande Colonnade Project, which forms part of the Louvre - Nouvelle Renaissance project.
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Large, complex cultural building (Musée du Louvre) — a building type that can be highly relevant for structural design and follow-on services. However, it is an architectural competition, not primarily a tender for structural services.
titel: International architectural competition for new access points and spaces in the Musée du Louvre and the design of its surroundings as part of the “Louvre – Grande Colonnade” project
kurzbeschreibung: International, restricted architectural competition for the creation of new visitor access points and underground spaces in the Musée du Louvre, as well as the comprehensive redesign of the adjacent open spaces (courtyards, gardens, squares and streets) as part of the large-scale “Louvre – Nouvelle Renaissance” project in Paris.
wettbewerb_art: Restricted international architectural competition (Maîtrise d’oeuvre) for museum and urban space redevelopment
gewinner: Group of economic operators represented by STUDIOS ARCHITECTURE (lead architect), with SELLDORF ARCHITECTS (associated office for design, scenography and museography) and BASE PARIS (landscape and urban design)
gewinner_rolle: Architectural consortium / general planner Maîtrise d’oeuvre
gewinner_kontakt: STUDIOS ARCHITECTURE, 103 Rue de Grenelle, 75007 Paris, France; E-mail: paris@studios.com; Tel.: +33 1 44 95 86 60; Internet: https://studios.com/fr/; Anticipated construction volume (works): 135685000 EUR net
projektbeteiligte:
Client/Maître d’ouvrage: EPML – Établissement Public du Musée du Louvre, Musée du Louvre - DFJM - SDJAP - Service de la commande publique, 75058 Paris Cedex 01, France (Contact: Thomas Combret, thomas.combret@louvre.fr, Tel.: +33 1 40 20 58 85).
Delegated client: OPPIC – Opérateur du Patrimoine et des Projets Immobiliers de la Culture (for the “Louvre Grande Colonnade” operation after appointment of the winner).
Winner / Maîtrise d’oeuvre: Consortium represented by STUDIOS ARCHITECTURE (lead architect), with SELLDORF ARCHITECTS (associated office for design, scenography and museography) and BASE PARIS (landscape and urbanism).
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Large, complex museum and cultural building project with substantial structural interventions (new access points, underground spaces, redesign of the surroundings)
- Structural design is not explicitly described as part of the competition, but is to be expected within the Maîtrise d’oeuvre services
- Internationally prominent reference (Louvre), potentially interesting for demanding refurbishment and roof/underpinning structures
- Location in France, not in the DACH region; cooperation more likely via the architectural team than directly with the client
- Strong focus on architecture, scenography and urban space; structural complexity not clearly identifiable from the TED text
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Project is located outside Germany; classic checking engineer services under the German system are not directly applicable
- Very large construction volume and complex existing structure (historic monument), fundamentally technically demanding
- No explicit tendering of independent checking services or checking engineer roles identifiable
- Potential rather for advisory specialist structural engineering or peer review within the Maîtrise d’oeuvre, if the architectural team sees a need
baukosten_erklaerung: taken from notice: stated in the TED text as “part de l’enveloppe financière prévisionnelle affectée aux travaux de construction” with 135 685 000 EUR HT
naechste_schritte: Contact the winning team (STUDIOS ARCHITECTURE, E-mail: paris@studios.com, Tel.: +33 1 44 95 86 60) to present sbp as a partner for complex structural solutions for refurbishment projects and long-span structures; optionally, also make informal contact with EPML (thomas.combret@louvre.fr) to position sbp as a specialist consultant for structures and special constructions in the further course of the project.
notes: Date of winner selection: 13.05.2026. The competition is a concours restreint de maîtrise d’oeuvre; the winner subsequently receives a negotiated design contract without a new tender. Structural design is not explicitly mentioned in the TED text, but is typically part of the Maîtrise d’oeuvre in France. The project volume also includes scenography and outdoor spaces; the second part of the overall operation (heritage works and vertical circulation in the Quadrilatère Sully) lies with the Architecte en Chef des Monuments Historiques and is not part of this competition.
